title: DQPSK Demodulator Baseband
text: Demodulate QPSK-modulated data, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Decision type} sets Demodulator output Hard; {Output type} sets the integer or bit pair output indicator, {Noise variance source} sets the source of noise variance, {Noise variance}, {Constellation ordering} sets the symbol mapping, {Phase offset (rad)} sets the phase offset of zeroth, {Output} and {Output data type}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Output type
params.values: Integer or bit pair output indicator Integer (default) | Bit

params.name: Decision type
params.values: Demodulator output Hard decision (default) | Log-likelihood ratio | Approximate log-likelihood ratio

params.name: Noise variance source
params.values: Source of noise variance estimate Dialog (default) | Port

params.name: Phase offset (rad)
params.values: Phase offset of zeroth point pi/4 (default) | scalar

params.name: Output
params.values: Output data type Same as input

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Output data type Inherit via internal rule (default) | Smallest unsigned integer | double | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | boolean
